name: C0_m
rationale: WHO 2023 age-standardised current cigarette prevalence, males 15+ (uploaded file); sd = assumed modelled-estimate error

name: C0_f
rationale: WHO 2023 age-standardised current cigarette prevalence, females 15+; female smoking may be under-reported

name: F0_m
rationale: WHO STEPS Armenia 2016 (cited in FCTC Needs Assessment 2020): former tobacco users (smoked and/or smokeless), men 18-69 = 14.2%. Definition/age/year differ from the cigarette baseline -> sd 0.02 is an assumed allowance

name: F0_f
rationale: WHO STEPS Armenia 2016 (FCTC Needs Assessment 2020): former tobacco users, women 18-69 = 0.9%; same definitional caveat

name: q_m
rationale: ASSUMPTION: annual quit probability among current smokers (low-to-middle-income range ~2-5%)

name: q_f
rationale: ASSUMPTION: as for men, slightly higher

name: m_exit
rationale: Annual exit (death/ageing out) replaced by never-smoking entrants; ~1/(adult life expectancy 15+)

name: rho_m
rationale: BAU relative annual change in male prevalence: 50% of log-linear slope of the SDG any-tobacco series (definition differs -> trend only), sd = max(SE, 0.01)

name: rho_f
rationale: As rho_m for females (tiny prevalence, very wide uncertainty)

name: RR_m
rationale: Lung cancer RR, long-duration current vs never smokers, men (broad literature range ~8-25)

name: RR_f
rationale: Lung cancer RR, current vs never smokers, women

name: kappa
rationale: Exponent of duration-dependence of excess risk (Doll & Peto: ~3-4.5)

name: half
rationale: Half-life (years) of the reducible excess risk after quitting

name: rinf
rationale: Share of excess risk that never disappears after quitting

name: psi_f0
rationale: ASSUMPTION: mean duration-weight of baseline former smokers' excess risk

name: g_m
rationale: ASSUMPTION: annual growth in male lung cancer counts from ageing/growth at constant rates; replace with WPP-based factor

name: g_f
rationale: ASSUMPTION: as above, females

name: phif
rationale: Female:male case-fatality ratio (needed because lung deaths by sex are not in the data)

name: cases_err
rationale: Multiplicative error of modelled GLOBOCAN incidence (larger: incidence is modelled)

name: death_err
rationale: Multiplicative error of GLOBOCAN deaths (mortality is the more direct anchor)

name: phi
rationale: Share of planned enforcement improvement actually implemented (implementation gap)

name: phi3
rationale: Share of the additional S3 measures actually implemented

name: bsf
rationale: Relative rise in quit hazard per +1 smoke-free compliance point (assumption)

name: gsf
rationale: Relative fall in initiation hazard per +1 compliance point (assumption)

name: eps_abs
rationale: |Price elasticity of cigarette demand|; typical low/middle-income value ~0.5

name: u
rationale: Share of demand elasticity operating through participation (prevalence) rather than intensity

name: tau
rationale: Pass-through of tax increase to retail price

name: reach
rationale: Annual share of smokers reached by cessation support (S3)

name: eff
rationale: Absolute increase in sustained quitting among those treated

name: media
rationale: Relative rise in quit hazard from mass-media campaigns

name: ad
rationale: Relative fall in initiation from stronger advertising restrictions

name: warn
rationale: Relative fall in initiation from improved warnings

name: omega
rationale: Overlap discount applied to the non-price S3 package to avoid double-counting
